Cutting $\frac{1}{2}$ into $4$ equal pieces makes the pieces $4$ times smaller.

alternativeExplanations.title: Picture it
steps: Half a pizza shared by 4 friends.
The whole pizza would give each person $\frac{1}{8}$ × 2 = wait — half gives each $\frac{1}{8}$ of the whole pizza.
